answer: Because the inlet solution is checked at the plume gate and logged, the nebula audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 22 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch therefore pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. The fee repeats 21 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
